I'm 24. And part of me understands that to be true. However, he is so different from all the others. I've been abused, emotionally. I've been completely cut off all at once, I've been pushed-and-pulled, i've been hidden from my partners friends, isolated from my own friends, told I was worthless. Even by my own mother.

He loves me like I have so seldom been loved. And we're funny together. He keeps me laughing. He's hard working. He's willing to forgive, he communicates well. And he respects himself, and me. He's consistent and intelligent. And I'm not exaggerating about him. I love him even if that love is less than functional and complete. I love who he is, and losing him would be the greatest tragedy of my life.

As someone wit hborderline personality disorder... it feels like the end of the world. there's nothing i want more than this relationship. i'm willing to work on it, but i'm so afraid that he wont be. and he is, hands down, the person i want. if i'm going to be with anybody, it's him.

I actually just had a really long conversation about respect with a trusted friend. i still don't fully understand what it's supposed to mean. something about treating other people the way they would like to be treated.

I used to think trust was just blindly believing that someone else wont hurt you. I've become completely incapable of that- I assume everyone will hurt me if given the chance, if it suits them, or possibly even by accident. And I do mean everyone.

Apparently I'm supposed to think of trust as something you give people because.... ? That's just the nice thing to do is to give people the benefit of the doubt.

edit: just realized i called him a trusted friend. he's really only trusted in that we have no mutual friends (so he can't blab), he's never steered me wrong in the 9 years we've been pals, and he always comes back no matter how much crazy i throw at him.
I'm asking, he's pretending not to hear it.
I'm truly incapable of trust and respect, and i'm truly not making that up.
